newsitem.title: USA: ConAgra names chief executive officer.
newsitem.headline: ConAgra names chief executive officer.

text.p: ConAgra Inc said Friday its board named Bruce Rohde, 48, as chief executive officer, effective September 25, succeeding Philip Fletcher, 64, who continues as chairman.
Rohde joined ConAgra in August 1996 as vice chairman and president. He previously was president of Omaha-based law firm McGrath, North, Mullin & Kratz PC and had been ConAgra's general counsel.
"It's been anticipated," Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said of Rohde's appointment as CEO. He continues as president.
Goldman Sachs analyst Nomi Ghez said Fletcher, who has been chairman since May 1993 and who was named CEO in September 1992, has told analysts he expects to retire next summer.
Ghez said that Rohde was identified previously as the heir apparent.

"This is outstanding and not unexpected news for ConAgra's shareholders and employees," Fletcher said in a statement. "I am completely confident he (Rohde) is the clear best choice to lead our company aggressively into the future."
